name: Corrupted Reliquary
desc: A defiled medallion humming with forgotten prayers. Its bearer hears voices that do not belong to the living.

name: Leather Carapace
desc: Layered hardened leather built to endure beatings that would shatter bone.

name: Iron Bulwark
desc: A forged iron breastplate. Deflects blades, shrapnel, and bad decisions.

name: Bandolier Rig
desc: Reinforced ammunition harness. Reloads become instinct.

name: Ethereal Shard
desc: A crystallized fragment of raw ether. Movement feels unnaturally precise.

name: Coyote Striders
desc: Crafted from desert predator hide. Silent steps, sudden bursts of speed.

name: Bone Fetish
desc: A ritual bone charm radiating unease. Enemies falter before striking.

name: Hammerlock Pistol
desc: A heavy-frame handgun built around impact force. Every shot lands with authority.

name: Lightcoil Repeater
desc: A spring-driven rapid firearm engineered for relentless firing rhythm.

name: Drumfeed Carbine
desc: A bulky drum-fed rifle designed for sustained combat. Heavy, loud, dependable.

name: Desert Machete
desc: A long, dust-worn blade built for close and quiet executions.

name: War Cleaver
desc: A brutal two-handed axe. Devastating impact, mercilessly slow.

name: Quickfang Knife
desc: A compact folding blade striking faster than thought.

name: Necrotic Serum
desc: A volatile vial of corrupted biomatter. Inject to graft unstable mutations.

name: Necrotic Serum (x3)
desc: Three doses of necrotic essence — sufficient for a major mutation graft.
